notes.title: Demo Performance Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849586/0f85027726237ff391a1ecb383a34890b61d8281.jpg"]

In this update

1- Performance increased by about 20%.

2- Sami's health has been reduced by 80%.

3- Adjusted the location of the guide widget showing how to unlock weapon attachments.

The Minimum System Requirements for the Demo Version are as follows;

* Intel Core-i5 2550K 3.4GHz / AMD FX 8120 3.1 GHz

* 4 GB RAM

* NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 GDDR5 / AMD RX 570 / RX 5500 XT

* 12 GB available space

Note: Low System Requirements are suitable for playing on the Lowest Settings (Performance Mode).

Recommended Version System Requirements are as follows;

* Intel Core-i7-10750H / AMD Ryzen 5 5600H

* 8 GB RAM

* NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600 XT

* 12 GB available space

Note: Recommended System Requirements are around 80 fps in Quality mode and 40 fps in Ultra Quality mode.
